title: normalizeName keeps surrounding whitespace
issue_text: normalizeName should trim surrounding whitespace before lower-casing a name.
expected_patch_hint: Trim the value before lower-casing it.

title: takeWindow returns one element too many
issue_text: takeWindow should return exactly limit elements starting at offset.

files.src/window.ts: export const takeWindow = <T>(items: T[], offset: number, limit: number) => items.slice(offset, offset + limit + 1);

expected_patch_hint: Remove the extra one from the slice end.

changes.content: export const takeWindow = <T>(items: T[], offset: number, limit: number) => items.slice(offset, offset + limit);

assertions.equals: export const takeWindow = <T>(items: T[], offset: number, limit: number) => items.slice(offset, offset + limit);

title: clamp ignores the upper bound
issue_text: clamp should never return a value above max while still respecting min.

files.src/clamp.ts: export const clamp = (value: number, min: number, max: number) => Math.max(min, value);

expected_patch_hint: Apply the upper bound after the lower bound.

changes.content: export const clamp = (value: number, min: number, max: number) => Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value));

assertions.equals: export const clamp = (value: number, min: number, max: number) => Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value));

title: isAdult rejects the exact age boundary
issue_text: A person who is exactly the minimum age should be considered an adult.

files.src/age.ts: export const isAdult = (age: number, minimum = 18) => age > minimum;

changes.content: export const isAdult = (age: number, minimum = 18) => age >= minimum;

assertions.equals: export const isAdult = (age: number, minimum = 18) => age >= minimum;

title: uniqueValues returns only duplicates
issue_text: uniqueValues should keep the first occurrence of each value and preserve input order.

files.src/unique.ts: export const uniqueValues = <T>(values: T[]) => values.filter((value, index) => values.indexOf(value) !== index);

expected_patch_hint: Keep entries whose first index is the current index.

changes.content: export const uniqueValues = <T>(values: T[]) => values.filter((value, index) => values.indexOf(value) === index);

assertions.equals: export const uniqueValues = <T>(values: T[]) => values.filter((value, index) => values.indexOf(value) === index);

title: pageCount drops a partial final page
issue_text: pageCount should include the final partially filled page.

files.src/pages.ts: export const pageCount = (items: number, pageSize: number) => Math.floor(items / pageSize);

changes.content: export const pageCount = (items: number, pageSize: number) => Math.ceil(items / pageSize);

assertions.equals: export const pageCount = (items: number, pageSize: number) => Math.ceil(items / pageSize);

title: sortNumbers uses lexicographic order
issue_text: sortNumbers should sort numeric values in ascending numeric order.
expected_patch_hint: Pass a numeric comparator to sort.

changes.content: export const sortNumbers = (values: number[]) => [...values].sort((left, right) => left - right);

assertions.equals: export const sortNumbers = (values: number[]) => [...values].sort((left, right) => left - right);

title: redactToken masks only the first occurrence
issue_text: redactToken should replace every occurrence of the token in a message.

files.src/redact.ts: export const redactToken = (message: string, token: string) => message.replace(token, "[REDACTED]");

expected_patch_hint: Use the all-occurrences string replacement API.

changes.content: export const redactToken = (message: string, token: string) => message.replaceAll(token, "[REDACTED]");

assertions.equals: export const redactToken = (message: string, token: string) => message.replaceAll(token, "[REDACTED]");

title: retryDelay starts at twice the base delay
issue_text: The first retry attempt should use the base delay, then double on each later attempt.

files.src/retry.ts: export const retryDelay = (baseMs: number, attempt: number) => baseMs * 2 ** (attempt + 1);

expected_patch_hint: Use the zero-based attempt directly as the exponent.

changes.content: export const retryDelay = (baseMs: number, attempt: number) => baseMs * 2 ** attempt;

assertions.equals: export const retryDelay = (baseMs: number, attempt: number) => baseMs * 2 ** attempt;

title: toSlug replaces only the first whitespace group
issue_text: toSlug should convert every whitespace group to one dash after trimming and lower-casing.
expected_patch_hint: Make the whitespace regular expression global.

title: toTimeoutMs returns seconds instead of milliseconds
issue_text: toTimeoutMs receives seconds and should return the equivalent integer milliseconds.
expected_patch_hint: Scale seconds by one thousand before rounding.

title: activeRecords keeps disabled entries
issue_text: activeRecords should return only records whose active flag is true.

files.src/records.ts:
export interface RecordItem { id: string; active: boolean; }
export const activeRecords = (records: RecordItem[]) => records.filter((record) => !record.active);

expected_patch_hint: Filter on the active value, not its negation.

changes.content:
export interface RecordItem { id: string; active: boolean; }
export const activeRecords = (records: RecordItem[]) => records.filter((record) => record.active);

assertions.equals:
export interface RecordItem { id: string; active: boolean; }
export const activeRecords = (records: RecordItem[]) => records.filter((record) => record.active);
